messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call -> High latency alert for customer Hegemonics in ap-southeast1 (dedicated pool). p95 jumped from ~1.8s to 5.3s, p99 3.2s -> 12s, errors ~0.1%. Triggering incident channel and paging @oncall-sre. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/shot/hegemonics-apse1
Maria Chen: oncall-sre here, I'm taking it. Confirming this is a dedicated pool + tenant=hegemonics?
Aj Patel: yes, dedicated pool dag-heap-01, tenant hegemonics. Stack shows long tail in tokenization + KV cache miss spike.
Lee Wong: confirming high queue length across nodes (queue_len > 8k), two nodes at 95% GPU util (nvml). Latency tail clearly correlates with queue depth.
Maria Chen: Kai, can we isolate the tenant to stop noisy neighbor? immediate tenant isolation then failover to fallback pool.
Kai Müller: starting isolation now. running: ```rdctl tenant isolate --customer hegemonics --pool dag-heap-01 --grace-period 30s``` will post job id when started. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Tenant eviction job started id=job-2026-03-17-009.
Sam Rivera: warming fallback in ap-southeast2 with lighter quantized model to reduce cost/latency: ```rdctl deploy-fallback --customer hegemonics --model goliath-quant-v2 --region ap-southeast2 --replicas 4```
Elena Rossi: @maria pinging CS/AE — I'll notify Hegemonics that we're performing an emergency failover and may see brief UX degradation. Scheduling a conf-call. :phone:
Aj Patel: suggestion: flush KV on the affected pool before eviction finishes, we see a miss-storm causing regen overhead. command: ```echo FLUSH | rd-runtime-kv --pool dag-heap-01```
Lee Wong: KV flush running... tombstones clearing. Early signs: p95 dropping to ~1.2s and p99 ~2.8s for non-evicted traffic.
Kai Müller: isolation complete. Hegemonics traffic migrated to fallback pool in ap-southeast2. Observing requests routing correctly. :white_check_mark:
Maria Chen: enabling full trace sampling for Hegemonics for 15m to capture traces for RCA: ```tracing set-sample --customer hegemonics --rate 100 --duration 15m```
Sam Rivera: fallback pool warmed, no elevated errors, latency stable at p95 ~800ms on fallback.
Elena Rossi: Hegemonics on call now, they confirm degraded UX earlier but accept fallback. They've asked for RCA and timeline.
Maria Chen: mitigation succeeded for now. Next steps: Aj owns postmortem, collect kernel/gpu logs, rd-runtime KV metrics, and scheduler traces. Schedule 1hr postmortem with Hegemonics at 15:30 APSE local. I'll update incident channel when we transition to monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigation_in_progress. Pager cleared. Will notify once we move to monitoring or resolve. :white_check_mark:
